faq.page_description: Find answers to common questions about crypto, trading strategies, and algorithmic trading.

general.title: General Questions
general.what_is_crypto.answer: Cryptocurrency is a digital asset using cryptography and decentralized networks. It allows peer-to-peer transactions without a central authority.
general.is_it_safe.answer: Crypto is generally secure if you use trusted wallets and exchanges. Always follow best security practices and be aware of scams.
general.resources.answer: You can learn more through blogs, documentation, and tutorials on crypto and trading concepts.

strategies.title: Trading Strategies
strategies.what_are.answer: Trading strategies are predefined plans used to enter and exit trades based on rules and market analysis.
strategies.types: What are types of trading strategies?
strategies.types.answer: Common strategies include trend-following, mean reversion, arbitrage, and scalping.
strategies.backtesting.answer: Backtesting allows you to test a strategy on historical data to evaluate performance before using it live.

algo.title: Algorithmic Trading
algo.what_is.answer: Algorithmic trading uses automated programs to execute trades based on predefined rules and strategies.
algo.how_it_works.answer: Algorithms monitor markets, analyze data, and place trades automatically without manual intervention.
algo.risks: What are the risks of algorithmic trading?
algo.risks.answer: Algorithmic trading carries risks such as software errors, market volatility, and execution delays.

learning.title: Learning & Resources
learning.courses.answer: Many online courses and tutorials cover crypto, trading strategies, and algo trading.
learning.blog: Can I use this platform for my own research?
learning.blog.answer: Our blog provides articles on concepts, strategies, and analysis of crypto markets.
learning.tools: What tools can I use for trading?
learning.tools.answer: Useful tools include charting software, backtesting platforms, and API access to crypto exchanges.
